newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH APRIL RETAIL SALES RISE 3.5 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH APRIL RETAIL SALES RISE 3.5 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The volume of Finnish retail sales rose 3.5 percent year-on-year in April, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
Adjusted for trading days, the volume of wholesales in April rose 10.1 percent year-on-year, SF said.
Wholesales increased across the board. Construction materials sale rose 19 percent year-on-year.

In retail sales construction materials sales increased seven percent year-on-year. Sales of electrical equipment and home appliances rose 10 percent year-on-year, SF said. Department store sales grew five percent but daily goods sales were flat.
